runtime_encoding: lossless 58-bit cache-line number plus one DEMAND/FILL kind bit
teacher_actions_are_model_inputs_scope: external or runtime inference inputs only
captured_spp_actions_role: fill-preserving normal replay and supervised labels only

lstm.architecture: separate demand/fill chronological LSTMs plus page-keyed causal LSTM, learned age-conditioned page-state validity, learned fusion, and a compact autoregressive exact-byte decoder
lstm.page_key: raw cache-line number decomposed by a documented 4096-byte architectural page; derived causally from the same address input
lstm.stateful_training: chronological TBPTT; routed and page-local hidden/cell values cross chunks and graph history is detached at chunk boundaries
lstm.action_training: STOP/EMIT is sampled at every reached rank; a separate shared teacher-prefix codec computes output likelihood only; only the model's actual hard increment, target, and fill are next-rank feedback
lstm.inference_history: fresh state followed by complete train, guard, and evaluation chronology; guard is causal warm-up/audit only

neural_action_decoder.request_count: rank-wise learned STOP/EMIT categorical grammar; first sampled STOP ends the sequence
neural_action_decoder.targets: exact autoregressive signed ZigZag plus canonical LEB128 increment, at most nine bytes for the complete 58-bit line domain
neural_action_decoder.increment_origin: callback line at rank zero, then the actual previously emitted target
neural_action_decoder.fill: two-class posterior predicted only after and conditioned on the actual emitted target
neural_action_decoder.feedback: actual hard LEB128 increment/target and actual hard fill one-hot; straight-through embeddings during training
neural_action_decoder.duplicate_handling: mask duplicate-target categorical probability within the callback, including continuation-prefix feasibility, and renormalize without fallback

teacher_count_role: labels STOP or EMIT only at ranks reached by the sampled rollout
teacher_prefix_role: loss-only exact autoregressive target-likelihood branch sharing runtime codec weights and legal masks
stochastic_decoding: stateless SHA-256 keyed categorical inverse CDF for STOP/EMIT, each LEB128 byte, and fill
event_key_definition: zero-based role-local decision index plus source-visible cache-line number
stop_emit_sampler_representability_check: STOP mass must be strictly above the open keyed-uniform half-bin
action_rollout_watchdog_role: raise the whole run without replay; never truncate or force STOP
optimizer_gradient_normalization: total categorical atom count per accumulation group
eviction_feedback_role: raw source-visible cache-fill callback routed through the fill recurrent path; no private SPP state
input_reuse: v18 input package is reused byte-for-byte; no recollection

v18_collapse_diagnosis.gate: binary mode decoding turns a weak conditional model with positive marginal above one half into almost-always emit
v18_collapse_diagnosis.count: rounding a learned conditional excess below one half collapses positive callbacks to exactly one action
v18_collapse_diagnosis.target: continuous mixture NLL and peak-density hard selection optimize different objects
v18_collapse_diagnosis.fill: fill was predicted independently before the actual target and amplified wrong-address cache pollution
v18_collapse_diagnosis.v19_change: replace all four factorized marginal decisions with a learned structured rank grammar and exact action trajectory

dynamic_state_accounting: report separate demand/fill hidden+cell state, per-seen-page hidden+cell state, and int64 last-position state in run metadata
